::: {.bs-status-panel}
[INTERACTIVE ANALYZER DEVELOPMENT SLICE]{.bs-status-label}

Build the position directly on the board, submit the accepted GNU / 1-ply request, then explore the recommendation and alternatives in the shared Results Viewer. Engine analysis remains on Node. Candidate boards appear only when a project-owned materializer supplied a verified movement/result asset.
:::

:::

```{=html}
<form class="bs-analyzer-request bs-position-workspace-form" data-bs-analyzer-form novalidate>
  <div class="bs-position-editor" data-bs-position-editor>
    <section class="bs-editor-board-panel" aria-labelledby="bs-editor-board-heading">
      <header class="bs-editor-section-heading">
        <div><span class="bs-status-label">POSITION</span><h2 id="bs-editor-board-heading">Edit the board</h2></div>
        <span class="bs-editor-turn-pill" data-bs-editor-turn-summary>Navy on roll</span>
      </header>

      <div class="bs-editor-toolbar" aria-label="Board actions">
        <button type="button" class="bs-button" data-bs-editor-action="start">Starting position</button>
        <button type="button" class="bs-button" data-bs-editor-action="clear">Clear board</button>
        <button type="button" class="bs-button" data-bs-editor-action="undo">Undo</button>
        <button type="button" class="bs-button" data-bs-editor-action="flip">Flip view</button>
        <button type="button" class="bs-button" data-bs-editor-action="remove">Remove selected</button>
      </div>

      <fieldset class="bs-editor-placement-side">
        <legend>Checker to place from an off tray</legend>
        <label><input type="radio" name="placement-side" value="player_0" checked> <span class="bs-player-dot bs-player-dot--player_0"></span> Copper</label>
        <label><input type="radio" name="placement-side" value="player_1"> <span class="bs-player-dot bs-player-dot--player_1"></span> Navy</label>
      </fieldset>

      <p class="bs-editor-instructions" id="bs-editor-instructions">Drag a checker, or select one and then select a point, bar, or off tray. With no checker selected, choosing a point places the selected colour from its off tray. Keyboard: <kbd>Enter</kbd> or <kbd>Space</kbd> selects and places; <kbd>Delete</kbd> removes a focused checker.</p>

      <div class="bs-editor-board-shell">
        <div class="bs-editor-off bs-editor-off--navy" data-bs-editor-off="player_1"></div>
        <div class="bs-editor-board" data-bs-editor-board aria-describedby="bs-editor-instructions"></div>
        <div class="bs-editor-off bs-editor-off--copper" data-bs-editor-off="player_0"></div>
      </div>

      <div class="bs-editor-board-meta" aria-label="Checker totals">
        <span><i class="bs-player-dot bs-player-dot--player_0"></i> Copper: <strong data-bs-editor-total="player_0">15</strong></span>
        <span><i class="bs-player-dot bs-player-dot--player_1"></i> Navy: <strong data-bs-editor-total="player_1">15</strong></span>
      </div>
      <p class="bs-editor-announcement" data-bs-editor-announcement aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"></p>
    </section>

    <section class="bs-editor-controls" aria-labelledby="bs-editor-controls-heading">
      <header class="bs-editor-section-heading"><div><span class="bs-status-label">POSITION FACTS</span><h2 id="bs-editor-controls-heading">Decision and match state</h2></div></header>

      <fieldset class="bs-analyzer-decision">
        <legend>Decision</legend>
        <label><input type="radio" name="decision" value="checker" checked> Checker</label>
        <label><input type="radio" name="decision" value="cube"> Cube</label>
      </fieldset>

      <fieldset class="bs-analyzer-decision">
        <legend>Player on roll</legend>
        <label><input type="radio" name="on_roll" value="player_0"> Copper</label>
        <label><input type="radio" name="on_roll" value="player_1" checked> Navy</label>
      </fieldset>

      <fieldset class="bs-analyzer-dice" data-bs-checker-dice>
        <legend>Checker dice</legend>
        <label for="bs-analyzer-die-1">Die 1</label>
        <select id="bs-analyzer-die-1" name="die1" data-bs-checker-die required>
          <option value="">Choose</option><option value="1">1</option><option value="2">2</option><option value="3">3</option><option value="4">4</option><option value="5">5</option><option value="6">6</option>
        </select>
        <label for="bs-analyzer-die-2">Die 2</label>
        <select id="bs-analyzer-die-2" name="die2" data-bs-checker-die required>
          <option value="">Choose</option><option value="1">1</option><option value="2">2</option><option value="3">3</option><option value="4">4</option><option value="5">5</option><option value="6">6</option>
        </select>
      </fieldset>

      <div class="bs-editor-control-grid">
        <label for="bs-editor-cube-value">Cube value
          <select id="bs-editor-cube-value" name="cube_value">
            <option>1</option><option>2</option><option>4</option><option>8</option><option>16</option><option>32</option><option>64</option><option>128</option><option>256</option><option>512</option><option>1024</option><option>2048</option><option>4096</option><option>8192</option><option>16384</option><option>32768</option>
          </select>
        </label>
        <label for="bs-editor-cube-owner">Cube owner
          <select id="bs-editor-cube-owner" name="cube_owner"><option value="centered">Centered</option><option value="player_0">Copper</option><option value="player_1">Navy</option></select>
        </label>
        <label for="bs-editor-match-length">Match length <span>(0 = unlimited)</span>
          <input id="bs-editor-match-length" name="match_length" type="number" inputmode="numeric" min="0" max="32767" step="1">
        </label>
        <label for="bs-editor-score-player-0">Copper score
          <input id="bs-editor-score-player-0" name="score_player_0" type="number" inputmode="numeric" min="0" max="32767" step="1">
        </label>
        <label for="bs-editor-score-player-1">Navy score
          <input id="bs-editor-score-player-1" name="score_player_1" type="number" inputmode="numeric" min="0" max="32767" step="1">
        </label>
      </div>

      <div class="bs-editor-rules">
        <label><input type="checkbox" name="crawford"> Crawford game</label>
        <label><input type="checkbox" name="jacoby"> Jacoby rule</label>
      </div>

      <section class="bs-editor-identifier" aria-labelledby="bs-editor-identifier-heading">
        <h3 id="bs-editor-identifier-heading">Complete GNUID</h3>
        <textarea data-bs-editor-identifier-output rows="2" readonly spellcheck="false" aria-label="Generated complete GNUID"></textarea>
        <button type="button" class="bs-button" data-bs-editor-action="copy">Copy GNUID</button>
      </section>

      <section class="bs-editor-import" aria-labelledby="bs-editor-import-heading">
        <h3 id="bs-editor-import-heading">Import complete GNUID</h3>
        <label class="visually-hidden" for="bs-editor-import-value">Complete GNUID to import</label>
        <input id="bs-editor-import-value" data-bs-editor-import type="text" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" placeholder="PositionID:MatchID">
        <button type="button" class="bs-button" data-bs-editor-action="import">Load into editor</button>
      </section>

      <div class="bs-editor-errors" data-bs-editor-errors role="alert" hidden></div>
    </section>
  </div>

  <input id="bs-analyzer-gnuid" name="gnuid" type="hidden">

  <div class="bs-analyzer-submit-row">
    <div class="bs-analyzer-profile" aria-label="Fixed analysis profile">
      <span><strong>Engine</strong> GNU</span><span><strong>Setting</strong> 1-ply</span><span><strong>Transport</strong> development only</span>
    </div>
    <button class="bs-button bs-button-primary" type="submit">Analyze this position</button>
  </div>
</form>

<section class="bs-analyzer-runtime-status" data-bs-analyzer-state="idle" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">
  <span class="bs-status-label" data-bs-analyzer-state-label>idle</span>
  <p data-bs-analyzer-state-detail>Edit the board and position facts, then analyze.</p>
  <code data-bs-analyzer-key hidden></code>
</section>
```

```{=html}
<div class="bs-analysis-results-host" data-bs-analyzer-results></div>
```

::::

::: {.bs-reading-column}

The editor permits structurally valid analysis positions; it does not judge move legality or reconstruct game history. The complete GNUID is generated locally from factual board and match state. GNU still performs all checker and cube analysis through the accepted Node request boundary. The result explorer never parses checker notation, generates moves, or invents a resulting position.

:::
